thesis: Character drift isn't fixed with better prompts -- it's fixed by locking identity once, from one reference image, inside a platform that carries it through every scene and clip.
frame: It's like casting the same actor for every scene of a movie instead of hiring a new lookalike for each one and hoping nobody notices the difference.

throughline.name: lucy-identity-card
throughline.description: the single character reference photo that gets stamped, unchanged, onto every new scene, background, and clip
throughline.evolution: starts as one uploaded portrait with a name attached, survives a variation pass into a new background, then a completely different scene (Japan street food), then gets animated into a moving video clip -- the same face, hair, and outfit recurring at every stage despite the setting changing completely each time

registers.to_anchor: I will see you in the next video
